title: CoworkerConfig
description: Behavioural knobs for a single coworker. Secrets, host binding, and development escape hatches stay in .env (see docs/adr/0007-config-file-vs-env-vars.md).

wake_mode.description: Activity source. 'tick' = periodic tick loop only. 'webhook' = wake HTTP server only (no scheduled ticks). 'both' = both (belt-and-suspenders; recommended).

extract_entities.description: Enable the per-tick entity evaluator that extracts people, projects, and workspace facts into state/entities and state/notes.md.

max_tools_per_tick.description: Maximum number of tool calls the coworker may chain within a single tick before the tick is force-closed.

pii_mask.description: Reversibly mask cloud identifiers (pod names, account IDs, IPs, UUIDs) in prompts so the LLM sees stable per-tick tokens instead of raw identifiers.

note_require_signed.description: Reject operator notes that lack a valid HMAC signature. Requires NOTE_HMAC_SECRET to be set; use bin/note-to.sh to write signed notes.
